title: Metal Skin Panic Madox-01
justification: Checked by title. The film is TMDB movie 62961 (Metal Skin Panic MADOX-01 (1987)). The node moves from TVDB 249857 to the OVA marker. TVDB series 249857 no longer exists. TheTVDB lists the work only as movie 64351 METAL SKIN PANIC MADOX-01 (1987-12-16), whose IMDb id tt0093529 and TMDB id 62961 are the node's own. AniDB types it an OVA, so the marker is OVA. AniDB S1-S4 are DVD extras with no episode anywhere.
